conditions: User is signed in with an item in the cart (badge shows '1')
User opens the menu and clicks Reset App State
items.expected: The Reset App State action completes (menu closes); the cart badge is no longer shown and the cart is empty

conditions: User opens the menu and clicks Logout
items.expected: The Logout action completes (the product list is no longer shown); the sign-in page is displayed

conditions: User logs out via the menu
User presses the browser back button
items.expected: The browser back navigation does not return the user to the product list; the sign-in page or an error message is shown instead

conditions: User logs out via the menu
User navigates back using browser history
items.expected: Session is invalidated after logout; navigating back does not expose the product list to the logged-out user

conditions: User is signed in and the side menu is open
items.expected: No WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations reported by axe-core on the menu area

excluded.reason: Both open bugs (#121 and #122) are unrelated to this story — #121 affects product image display, #122 affects checkout completion; neither touches menu reset or logout behaviour
